task: Read Surya Deo's Facebook profile in Chrome and identify useful research leads for the Odia cinema series.
method: Signed-in Chrome UI. Read seven expanded public posts and inspected the profile's book-cover photograph and Maa O Mamata advertisement. Selected visible material, not an exhaustive profile review. No reactions, comments, messages, follows or downloads.

findings.title: ଲୋକସ୍ୱର ଛାଞ୍ଚ
findings.summary: Deo discusses call-and-response in Odia folk singing and conversational duets in recordings and cinema. He names Akshaya Mohanty, Trupti Das and lyricist Sirshananda Das Kanungo.
findings.limits: His musical interpretation. Verify exact recording identities, credits and contexts before article claims. No first/only assertion.

findings.title: କୋରସ୍ ଗାୟନ: ଅର୍ଥ ଆଉ ଇତିହାସ
findings.summary: A post on Akshaya Mohanty's chorus work connects Jajabara, radio work and the Utkal Choral Group.
findings.use: Research ensemble singers, arranging and shared musical labour.
findings.limits: Do not repeat his unverified proportion claim about most Odia chorus repertoire. Utkal Choral Group, Salila Trushna and Jouban details need further corroboration.

findings.summary: Deo announced an OFDC screening at Kalinga Studio on25October2026 and showed a historical newspaper advertisement. He identifies it as a Samaja advertisement from12September1980, the film's release date.
findings.corroboration: Ommcom25Oct2026 reports the completed screening of Lahari and1980's Maa O Mamata at the OFDC Golden Jubilee. Root directly read the report.
findings.use: Concrete example of archival-era cinema returning to an audience.
findings.limits: Exact original clipping date and 'first advertisement' attribution are from Deo, not an inspected full newspaper issue. Rights and advertised time not independently corroborated. Screening is not evidence of a restored negative or an open online film.

findings.summary: Deo reflects on the difficulty of finding films and says Ashanta Graha is unavailable to him despite surviving images.
findings.limits: Personal search testimony, not proof every copy is lost. Do not generalize his frustration into a claim that nobody else preserves cinema.

findings.title: ସିନ୍ଦୂର ବିନ୍ଦୁରୁ ସୁନା ସଂସାର
findings.summary: Deo reproduces an account attributed to director Shishir Mishra from Banichitra, New Year1978, edited by Parikshit Jena. It describes pooled finance, bank loans and personal capital; a story by Manmath Nath Das; the earlier working title Paribar; and production-management lessons.
findings.use: Highest-value lead for cinema economics, literary adaptation and creator experience.
findings.limits: Original magazine not inspected. Preserve author/editor/reposting provenance. Treat financing and recollections as testimony until checked. Omit unsupported blame passages and all-copies-unavailable assertion. Facebook displayed an AI-content label on this post, so attached imagery should not be assumed archival.

findings.summary: A Nuakhai song post links a remembered song to Akashvani Sambalpur.
findings.use: Potential expansion of the radio story beyond Cuttack.
findings.limits: No broadcast date, song identification or credits established in this pass. Not a claim to have found the first Nuakhai broadcast.

findings.summary: Deo discusses Pranab Patnaik's Sucharita song alongside Chitralekha and Sushama in modern Odia song, and analyses singing style and radio/record circulation.
findings.use: Literature, imagined heroines, song and radio connection; links back to earlier Nayika research.
findings.limits: Stable post permalink not recovered. Treat singing analysis as his interpretation. Do not reproduce unsupported popularity rankings, exclusive-style assertions or no-gramophone-record claim as verified facts.

findings.summary: Inspected the profile cover showing Odia Cinema Geeta, second volume, with historical recording-session photographs.
findings.use: Visual bibliographic lead and route to lyricist/composer/singer records.
findings.limits: Image is not a title/copyright page; edition dates and year ranges mentioned in comments are not verified. No licence for reuse established.

independent_related_source.title: Prasar Bharati Archive honours the great Upendra Bhanja and Akshaya Mohanty
independent_related_source.summary: Akashvani Samvaad documents Prasar Bharati Archives releases containing Baidehisha Bilasa and35Akshaya Mohanty Akashvani songs under Punyara Nadi Tire. Root directly read.
independent_related_source.limits: Supports the archive release and radio repertoire, not the specific chorus-history assertions or current media availability.

review.quality: Drishti reviewed the proposed interpretation and prioritized original-magazine verification, exact music credits and qualified preservation claims. No human approval claimed.
